name: BSP_LuaGame_EndScene
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol; the Lua name is recovered. Packet cc_exe_2g, read-only analysis. __fastcall(LuaState*) -> int returning 0, body 008b01b0-008b0465. Registered as the Lua global 'EndScene' (the 560-row binding table of 006b8610; src/mission_lua_host.cpp row {EndScene, 008b01b0}). It reads the commit slot's scoring record at [00e188a8+21A0h] + 4 + [[..+21A0h]+1424h]*284h: when that record's +0h (mission_completed_00) is clear AND the session is single player ([game+1FE4h] == 0) it tests 007f8d60 and raises a menu prompt through BSP_MenuPromptScreen_Raise 00531b00 with 00530670 or 00530c20, returning WITHOUT ending the scene; otherwise it calls BSP_Game_EndScene 004d7970. Scripts/global/commandhelpers.lua reaches it as luaDelay(EndScene, 12) from luaMissionCompleted_ComplText when the mission has no completion movie, so a script must call Scoring_SetMissionCompleted before ending a mission this way. docs/MISSION_RESULT_DECISION.md, docs/GAME_EXECUTABLE.md milestone 2g correction 9. | Oct24 poolB: complete normal body lua_game_end_scene_008b01b0 in src/engine_seg56_cc13.cpp. Full008B01B0..008B0465 normal path: actual native temporary strings and debug flag, commit/mode tests, qualified stock tree membership, exact checkpoint/restart prompt args and navigation calls, alternate end-scene(0). New source API, not native FH3/ABI or game validation.
